diagnosis.root_cause: TLS client certificate for pay-gw.example.net expired at 2026-05-04T03:40:00Z, causing billing-api to fail payment gateway calls with tls_handshake_failed, which cascaded into sustained 502 errors on POST /v1/invoices/pay across edge-proxy and invoice-worker.

claims.text: billing-api logs show a TLS client certificate for pay-gw.example.net expiring at 2026-05-04T03:40:00Z, with warnings starting at 00:43:30Z (2.9 hours left).

citations.quote: 2026-05-04T00:43:30.836Z WARN  billing-api[billing-1] tls: client certificate expires soon peer=pay-gw.example.net cert=pay-gw-client not_after=2026-05-04T03:40:00Z hours_left=2.9

claims.text: After the certificate expiry, billing-api logs show repeated ERROR entries for charge failures with reason=tls_handshake_failed on pay-gw.example.net, starting at 03:41:00Z and continuing at high frequency.

citations.quote: 2026-05-04T03:41:00.950Z ERROR billing-api[billing-1] payments: charge failed upstream=pay-gw.example.net status=502 reason=tls_handshake_failed
2026-05-04T03:41:46.345Z ERROR billing-api[billing-2] payments: charge failed upstream=pay-gw.example.net status=502 reason=tls_handshake_failed
2026-05-04T03:42:02.079Z ERROR billing-api[billing-3] payments: charge failed upstream=pay-gw.example.net status=502 reason=tls_handshake_failed
2026-05-04T03:48:33.417Z ERROR billing-api[billing-1] payments: charge failed upstream=pay-gw.example.net status=502 reason=tls_handshake_failed

claims.text: edge-proxy logs show sustained 502 responses on POST /v1/invoices/pay with upstream=billing-api from 03:40:25Z onward, and invoice-worker logs show repeated charge failed errors with reason=billing-api 502, confirming the cascade.

citations.quote: 2026-05-04T03:40:25.987Z INFO  edge-proxy[edge-2] proxy: POST /v1/invoices/pay status=502 dur_ms=53 upstream=billing-api req=a88c9e01 ip=192.0.2.30
2026-05-04T03:41:28.051Z INFO  edge-proxy[edge-1] proxy: POST /v1/invoices/pay status=502 dur_ms=55 upstream=billing-api req=f67f0527 ip=192.0.2.250

remediation_plan.action: Renew the TLS client certificate for pay-gw.example.net (cert=pay-gw-client) and deploy it to all billing-api instances.
remediation_plan.why: The certificate expired at 2026-05-04T03:40:00Z, causing TLS handshake failures on every payment gateway call; renewing it restores the trust chain.
remediation_plan.risk: If the new certificate is misconfigured or not rolled out to all billing-api pods, payment failures will persist.

remediation_plan.action: Add a certificate expiry monitoring alert (e.g., 30-day and 7-day warnings) for pay-gw-client to prevent recurrence.
remediation_plan.why: The incident began with a WARN at 2.9 hours left, which was too late to prevent outage; earlier alerts give time to rotate certificates.
remediation_plan.risk: Alert fatigue if thresholds are not tuned; false positives if monitoring reads wrong certificate store.

remediation_plan.action: Restart billing-api pods after certificate deployment to ensure they pick up the renewed certificate immediately.
remediation_plan.why: Some runtimes cache TLS credentials at startup; a rolling restart guarantees the new certificate is used without waiting for natural pod turnover.
remediation_plan.risk: Brief capacity dip during rolling restart; mitigate by draining connections first.
